author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I chat with AI about philosophy, then turn the dialog into a college level essay

In this inquiry, I asked exactly question the natural of writing a philosophy essay in the AI-era.

If I truly understand the essay, I can defense it vobally, I can carry on the research with the help of AI, does it matter if the essay isn't 100% come from my brain?

shared_article.title: Who Is Thinking? Artificial Intelligence, Authorship, and the Purpose of Philosophy
